rebecca: Quick sync: I'm preparing a docs PR to add a Go SDK example for Optimize that demonstrates batching + prefix cache + a compact quant profile. Also fixing a broken anchor under /optimize/quantization and adding a one-line migration checklist. Will keep the example minimal for copy-paste.
omar: Love it. Go example is missing across our snippets. Can you paste the snippet here so I can double-check import paths and naming?
rebecca: Draft Go snippet (to go under docs/examples/sdk/go):
```go
package main
import (
  "context"
  "fmt"
  "os"
  "github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-go"
)
func main() {
  client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
  resp, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), &redwood.GenerateRequest{
    Model: "redwood/compact-go-1",
    Input: "Summarize the paragraph in one sentence.",
    Batching: &redwood.Batching{MaxBatchTokens: 1024},
    Cache: &redwood.CacheConfig{Mode: "prefix", MaxPrefixKv: 2048},
    QuantProfile: "q4_0_fast"
  })
  if err != nil {
    panic(err)
  }
  fmt.Println(resp.Text)
}
```
lucy: Nice. Two quick nits: 1) add a single-line comment above `MaxBatchTokens` about latency vs cost; 2) mention that `q4_0_fast` prefers speed with small quality delta.
sam: I'll run repo-wide grep for `/optimize/quantization` vs old `/optimize/legacy/quant` anchors and add a redirect rule in the PR. Also we should include a short YAML quant profile example in the docs so users can copy it into their deployment manifests.
rebecca: Draft quant YAML (very small):
```yaml
profiles:
  q4_0_fast:
    type: q4_0
    prefer_speed: true
    kv_cache_shrink: 0.5
  int8_safe:
    type: int8
    prefer_speed: false
    fp_residual: true
```
omar: For tests: add a 3-prompt smoke test under docs/tests/optimize that checks for non-empty response and one expected keyword per prompt. Keeps CI cheap.
lucy: Also update the Optimize migration checklist with a short line: "If you used /optimize/legacy/quant anchors, update links to /optimize/quantization/profiles and review quant profile names."
sam: I pushed the redirect and fixed two stale links in other docs. Rebecca, can you add a short changelog entry under Optimize -> Docs changes?
rebecca: Will do. Plan: I'll open PR after adding the smoke tests and changelog. Tagging @omar and @lucy for review. ETA today.
